entities.summary: Mouloukou Souleyman Diabate, commonly known as Solo Diabate, is an Ivorian basketball player for Dar City Basketball Club. After playing a decade in France and some years in North Macedonia, China and Slovakia, Diabate began his career at the African continent in 2021. He is a two-time BAL champion, with Zamalek in 2021 and US Monastir in 2022.
